experiment_template.research_question: Asking GLM to regenerate invariant envelope metadata causes avoidable initial schema omissions.
stop_conditions: Never expand the declared attempt cap to replace failures.
No live execution until exact candidate, fixtures, sample size, thresholds and physical-call cap are bound.
Stop on source or fixture drift; retain receipts.

controls: Freeze source, fixture, prompt, scorer and budget hashes before execution.
Separate initial response, correction, transport retry and final verification.
Preserve all failed and missing observations; do not pool changing candidates.
success_criteria.prediction: Compare raw model fidelity separately from host-normalized validity; require semantic non-regression.
success_criteria.sample_size_status: unbound; three repetitions is a design minimum, not a powered sample size
success_criteria.treatment: Separate arms: explicit metadata correction card; minimal model payload with deterministic host envelope and full final-schema validation.

records.falsifier: On held-out tasks, explicit metadata guidance does not reduce raw omissions; a host envelope merely masks them without improving useful task success.
records.mechanism: Constant administrative fields compete with code generation; a prompt card or host-owned envelope may reduce omissions.
records.scope: GLM small-window behavior; prospective untested explanation. No causal conclusion or activation.
records.statement: Asking GLM to regenerate invariant envelope metadata causes avoidable initial schema omissions.

records.claim: The baseline omitted only schema_version; its raw proposed source independently passed all six hidden cases. The original end-to-end failure is retained.
limitations: Host-envelope had a semantic failure on this same block.
One omission supports a failure mechanism, not a causal treatment effect.

records.next_action: Continue paired trials and report contract validity separately from semantics; do not adopt host-envelope from one omission.
